description: S45 T12 (PM15/PM16): policy.list filtered by PROVENANCE. The `origin` param keeps one provenance — 'system' for rows the seed process wrote (the declared policy.corpus set), 'user' for operator-authored rows, 'import' reserved; a value outside the three is a -32602 naming it (the boundary's ParseOrigin owns the set). Each view carries its own `origin` beside createdAt: a listing that can say 'the machine seeded this' is what stops a system rule from reading as an operator's. Origin is provenance, never policy content — the evaluator reads none (PM11), and the filter's policy half (type/target/source/action/expiry) is untouched by it. The ids here are the seed identity unchanged from S11: corpus.<agent>.<hash>, the agent component the corpus name.
